intro: East Carbon, formed from the merger of the former mining towns of Dragerton and Columbia, sits directly in the Book Cliffs coal field in eastern Carbon County. Mineral ownership here traces closely to the coal companies and homestead patents that shaped the area's early development, and many interests have been divided among multiple heirs over the decades since.
We buy mineral, coal royalty, and coalbed methane interests near East Carbon directly, and we will confirm exactly what your family owns before making a written offer.

sections.heading: A town built entirely on coal
